title: AINM Protocol - Memory Management Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for the three-tier memory model: context frames, memory store/query/evict operations, and archival facts. See memory.md.

ArchivalFact.description: A unit of archival memory. Structured key-value record with metadata. See memory.md Section 3.3.

fact_id.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for this fact.

value.description: Fact content. May be a string or JSON object. Maximum 4KB when serialized.

tags.description: Categorization tags for filtering during queries. Max 10 tags, each 1-64 characters.

stored_by.description: AINM address of the participant who stored this fact. Set by server from authenticated session.

stored_at.description: Timestamp when the fact was stored. Set by server.

ContextFrame.description: Structured context payload delivered to a participant. Contains active context, conversation summary, archival facts, and participant list. Budget: 32KB max with 50/20/20/10 split (recent messages / summary / archival / participants). See memory.md Section 4.

thread_id.description: The thread this context frame pertains to.

active_context.description: Active context tier: recent messages + thread metadata. ~50% of context frame budget.

recent_messages.description: Recent message summaries ordered chronologically (oldest first).

window_start.description: Beginning of the active context window.

message_count.description: Total messages in the thread at frame assembly time.

conversation_summary.description: Server-generated summary of conversation history beyond active context. null for new threads or if server does not support summarization. ~20% of budget.

archival_facts.description: Relevant archival facts for the receiving participant. Only the participant's own facts. ~20% of budget.

participants.description: Current thread participants with presence. ~10% of budget.

MemoryStoreParams.description: Parameters for ainm.memory.store. Stores a fact in the authenticated participant's archival memory. Key collision = replacement. See memory.md Section 5.1.

thread_id.description: Thread context for audit trail (archival facts persist across conversations).

tier.description: MUST be 'archival'. Active context and conversation memory are server-managed.

MemoryQueryParams.description: Parameters for ainm.memory.query. Queries conversation memory or archival memory. See memory.md Section 5.2.

query.description: Text search query. For conversation: searches message content. For archival: semantic search over fact values.

key.description: For archival tier: exact key or key prefix match.

tags.description: For archival tier: filter by tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination).

time_range.description: For conversation tier: filter messages by time range.

from_identity.description: For conversation tier: filter messages by sender.

MemoryQueryResult.description: Response for ainm.memory.query. See memory.md Section 5.2.

results.description: Query results. For archival tier: array of ArchivalFact. For conversation tier: array of message summaries.

truncated.description: True if more results exist beyond the limit.

MemoryEvictParams.description: Parameters for ainm.memory.evict. Removes a fact from archival memory. See memory.md Section 5.3.

tier.description: MUST be 'archival'. Only archival facts can be evicted by participants.

fact_id.description: Server-assigned fact ID for targeted eviction.

key.description: Fact key for key-based eviction. Either fact_id or key must be provided.

MemoryCapabilities.description: Memory capabilities declared during ainm.initialize negotiation. See memory.md Section 6.

conversation.description: Whether conversation memory queries are supported.

archival.description: Whether archival memory operations are supported.

maxContextFrameSize.description: Maximum context frame size in bytes. Recommended default: 32KB (32768 bytes).

MemoryErrorCodes.description: Memory-specific JSON-RPC error codes in the range -32050 to -32055. See memory.md Section 8.

-32051.description: Attempted to write to conversation or active tier (only archival is writable).

-32052.description: Participant's archival storage quota has been exceeded.

-32053.description: Fact object failed validation (key format, value size, tag constraints).

-32054.description: Referenced fact_id or key does not exist in the participant's archival store.

-32055.description: Assembled context frame exceeds max_context_frame_size. Server truncation failed.
